_about: Every word the page shows that is not an item's or an upgrade's (those are in items.json and upgrades.json).
title: Pursuer
subtitle: Don't hold on to anything for too long.
credit: Made by Sam Gilson. Built with Builder: a Rust core, a WebAssembly shim and a WebGL page. Art drawn in TikZ.
music_note: Pick the chase music on the record player in the house.
pieces_loosed: pieces of the city knocked loose
